text.title: Source Routing Record — Output Contract
text.summary: The artefact this methodology produces: a Source Routing Record as YAML or JSON, machine-checkable by the bundled validator.

contract.field: Which agent or runtime this routing applies to.
Maximum concurrently connected MCP servers. `0` is a valid and common answer (r4).
Measured tool-definition footprint of the routed MCP set, per request. Diagnostic unit.
The same charge expressed in currency, e.g. "USD 0.12 per session at current volume" (r1).
Whether definitions are fetched on demand rather than sent up front.
What happens when the agent needs a tool it has not fetched (r4).

Every source the agent needs. Each item: `name`, `capability` (what the agent needs from it), `cli_available` (bool), `cli_binary` (required when routed to cli), `route` (cli|mcp|neither), `cli_insufficient_reason` (required when `cli_available` is true and route is mcp), `mcp_justification` (required when route is mcp; one of stateful-session|oauth-brokered|push-subscription|no-cli-exists), `first_party` (bool, required when route is mcp), `credential_scope` (required when route is mcp), `spec_revision` (required when route is mcp), `migration_deadline` (required when `spec_revision` predates 2026-07-28), `reason` (required when route is neither).

section.title: Stop condition
section.statement: When every source routes to `cli` or `neither`, the record is COMPLETE with `server_cap: 0`, a zero footprint and no MCP-specific fields anywhere. This is the common outcome for an agent that can execute commands, and it is the cheapest one — no standing charge, no trust boundary widened, no protocol revision to track.

section.title: Consistency rules the validator enforces
section.statement: The count of sources routed to `mcp` must not exceed `server_cap`, and `server_cap: 0` forbids any MCP route. A source with `cli_available: true` routed to `mcp` requires a non-empty `cli_insufficient_reason`. Every MCP route requires an `mcp_justification` drawn from the closed list, `first_party: true`, a non-empty `credential_scope` and a `spec_revision`; a revision earlier than 2026-07-28 requires a `migration_deadline`. A `stateful-session` justification against `spec_revision: 2026-07-28` is rejected as contradictory. Every `cli` route requires a `cli_binary`; every `neither` route requires a `reason`. Any field or reason text citing registry listing as justification is rejected. `definition_footprint_tokens` must be 0 when no source routes to MCP.
